estimates.name: Business Combinations and Asset Acquisitions
estimates.t: We account for acquisitions of businesses under ASC 805 and allocate the fair value of purchase consideration to the tangible and intangible assets purchased and the liabilities assumed on the basis of their fair values at the date of acquisition.

estimates.name: Useful Life and Amortization of Acquired Intangible Assets
estimates.t: We amortize acquired finite-lived intangible assets over their estimated useful lives, using the pattern in which their economic benefit is consumed.
